tbesh_html:
1) to sound a trumpet
1a) (Piel) players on clarions (participle)
1b) (Hiphil) sound with clarions (participle)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר; as dem. from H2689 (חֲצֹצְרָה);
